# FreelancerOS

FreelancerOS (https://freelanceros.mehyar.us) is a one-time $29 freelancer
operating system by MehyarSoft LLC: a token-gated web dashboard with a client
tracker (follow-up reminders), a branded invoice generator with PDF export, a
4-stage content pipeline board, and a downloadable template pack (freelancer
contract, proposal template, client onboarding form).

- Free interactive demo: https://freelanceros.mehyar.us/demo.html (sample data, no signup)
- Pricing: $29 one-time, no subscription, 7-day money-back guarantee
- Checkout: centralized Stripe checkout at https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout
- Support: info@mehyar.us
